correctness.rationale: All six finite grid face sets were independently regenerated from forbidden independent four-subsets. An independent free-face priority matching leaves respectively 1 vertex and 4,20,56,84,220,560 critical 5-faces, with 192,697,1792,2363,5753,13518 matched pairs; complete matched Hasse directed graphs were topologically sorted, not merely counted. D4 signed fixed-face traces for side 3,4,5 are [4,0,0,0,0,0,-2,-2], [84,0,4,0,-10,-10,-10,-10], [560,0,0,0,0,0,-28,-28]. An acyclic Morse CW complex with only one 0-cell and 5-cells is the claimed wedge. The claim is only for 3<=m<=n<=5, not all grids or equivariant homotopy.
